messages:
Sarah: kicking off BrightWave POC scoping thread. Need to lock success criteria, integration approach (SDK vs REST), auth/SSO, rate limits, streaming behavior, and retry strategy. Who owns what and can we do a 3-week POC?

Jake: quick summary for context — BrightWave wants chat + embeddings for search re-rank. Target success metrics they shared: embeddings avg cosine >= 0.78 on eval, chat latency not degrade more than 10% vs their baseline, and target effective cost ~ $0.10/token during POC. They also require data isolation and audit logs.

Priya: they need token-level streaming for interactive UI and a nightly batch pipeline for embeddings. Also asked whether client-side retries will handle interrupted streams or we need server resume.

Marta: security constraints: Okta SSO for console, API keys rotated monthly, and KMS for any PII. I will own the security questionnaire and KMS plan.

Jake: recommendation for integration: use our JS SDK for chat streaming (it has built-in reconnect and resume helpers) and REST/bulk endpoints for embedding ingestion. Example SDK snippet we suggest for the client: 

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-large-v1', messages })
stream.on('data', chunk => render(chunk.delta || chunk.text))
stream.on('error', err => {
  // exponential backoff + resume logic here
})
```

Priya: capacity planning Q: they expect ~50 concurrent interactive users and a nightly batch of ~20k embeddings. Can we suggest quotas?

Marta: infra suggestion: reserve a small Dedicated pool for the POC (equivalent to 2x A10G) to stabilize latency. Hosted is feasible but we should set explicit quotas: chat quota = 200 qps, embeddings bulk throttle = 1k/min for the POC window.

Jake: retry guidance: for streaming, client should retry on transient network errors using exponential backoff and try to resume the stream. For non-streaming generation, recommend idempotency keys so the server can de-duplicate retries.

Priya: proposed success checklist:
- functional: SDK chat integrated, nightly embedding pipeline up and ingesting index
- quality: embedding cosine >= 0.78 on a 500-sample eval set
- perf: 95th percentile chat reply latency < 450ms
- cost: estimated POC spend <= $6,000 for 3 weeks
- security: Okta SSO + monthly key rotation + KMS + audit logs configured

Sarah: owners: Jake = integration lead (SDK, retries, client patterns), Marta = security & infra (dedicated pool + KMS + questionnaires), Priya = evals & prompts (build eval harness + sample prompts), Sarah = sales/ops (billing, contract). Timeline: Week 0 onboarding + infra; Week 1 SDK integration + embeddings pipeline; Week 2 tuning + evals; Week 3 final report & handoff.

Jake: engineering blockers: do we have a documented resume flow for client streaming reconnects? @DeployBot can we surface docs and flags. Also, can we configure Okta SSO in ~2 business days?

DeployBot: streaming-resume is available behind a canary flag; docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/streaming-resume. Okta SSO initial scaffolding estimated 2 business days for first config and test.

Marta: I'll drop the security questionnaire draft here by EOD tomorrow with KMS integration steps and audit retention policy.

Priya: I'll prepare the 500-sample eval + prompt set and a small synthetic disconnect test to validate retry/resume semantics.

Sarah: next actions: Jake post SDK integration checklist by EOD, Marta upload sec questionnaire draft, Priya share eval prompts. Weekly sync Friday 10am. Any objections?

Jake: none, will post checklist here shortly.

Marta: ack.

Priya: ack :thumbsup: 

Sarah: thanks all — tagging customer in our CRM: @brightwave-eng. We'll DM the onboarding doc once infra is ready.
